shortDescription.default: Leave and time-off management for SharePoint and Microsoft Teams.

longDescription.default: Brillienta Time Off Manager runs inside SharePoint Online and Microsoft Teams and keeps all data in SharePoint lists on your own site. It includes 30 leave types; fixed, accrual, grade-based and tenure-based entitlements with proration and carry-forward; comp off (in lieu) with expiry; full-day, half-day and hourly (two-hour) leave; non-working days and holiday calendars; recurring and bi-weekly leave; leave templates; multilevel approval workflows with delegation, reminders, escalation, auto-approval and approval on behalf of the manager; submitting on behalf of employees; cancellation with approval; a team calendar with Outlook/Teams calendar sync; reports and exports; Power Automate events, a webhook, the REST API and Power BI. Custom theme, brand and logo. Includes a 14-day free trial. Microsoft Graph permissions: User.Read.All (import employees) and Calendars.ReadWrite (add approved leave to the person's own calendar), both optional.
